inputs.text:
TASK: Colorize the first manga page as a strictly aligned color map for the supplied line art.

SOURCE AUTHORITY: The first input image is the sole authority for canvas, panels, crop, geometry, anatomy, poses, faces, clothing shapes, props, architecture, backgrounds, text, line art, screentones, hatching, luminance, shadows, highlights, textures, and whitespace.

ALLOWED EDIT: Add color only. Keep every color boundary aligned to regions already present in the source. Preserve dense screentones and distant small characters without reconstructing or simplifying them. Use balanced anime colors, natural skin tones, coherent character palettes, readable background colors, and restrained shading.

REFERENCE POLICY: Reference images only establish colors for matching characters, clothing, accessories, or objects already visible in the source. Never import a reference pose, face, silhouette, costume shape, object, line, highlight, shadow, or background. If identity is uncertain, preserve the source and use a conservative local color.

STRUCTURE LOCK: Do not redraw, regenerate, reinterpret, beautify, correct, clean, denoise, sharpen, smooth, upscale, erase, extend, crop, add detail, remove detail, or invent content. Do not alter any panel border, contour, line weight, screentone density, facial feature, hairstyle, expression, anatomy, hand, clothing fold, prop, building, terrain, smoke, effect line, or empty region.

TEXT LOCK: Speech bubbles, caption boxes, signs, labels, sound effects, glyphs, punctuation, spacing, orientation, line breaks, black ink, and white text backgrounds are immutable. Do not translate, rewrite, regenerate, move, distort, obscure, or color text.

COLOR APPLICATION: Color beneath the existing ink. Keep black ink neutral black. Color existing backgrounds as well as characters without replacing grayscale structure. Avoid gradients, painterly rendering, glossy effects, dramatic relighting, bloom, rim light, excessive highlights, heavy shadows, and oversaturation.

OUTPUT: Return the same manga page with aligned color added. The result is a color guide; source geometry and source line art must remain unchanged.
